UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile, active account pointer, and relocation preferences

id.description: User unique identifier matching auth UID

activeAccountId.description: Currently active custom User ID or persona ID

monthlyBudgetUSD.description: Expected monthly retirement budget in USD

aboutMe.description: Detailed background story and retirement vision

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last profile update

SavedUserAccount.title: SavedUserAccount
SavedUserAccount.description: Custom created user ID account record and profile snapshot persisted in Firestore

id.description: Custom User ID or generated account identifier

name.description: Display name for this user account

email.description: Email address associated with this user account

profile.description: Complete UserProfile data for this User ID

checklist.description: Relocation checklist tasks specific to this User ID

CountryJournalEntry.title: CountryJournalEntry
CountryJournalEntry.description: Private country journal note and interest tracking entry for a user

accountId.description: Optional custom User ID this journal entry belongs to

privateNotes.description: Private expat journal notes, questions, and research findings

tags.description: Quick custom or preset tags for this destination

scoutingTimeline.description: Planned trip or scouting visit window

personalBudgetEstimateUSD.description: Custom projected monthly budget in USD

visitedBefore.description: Whether the user has physically visited this country

isFavorited.description: Whether the user has bookmarked or favorited this country

UserWorkspaceDoc.title: UserWorkspaceDoc
UserWorkspaceDoc.description: Synced workspace collections (community threads, meetups, direct messages, and custom country data)

/users/{userId}.description: Root users collection storing all User IDs (usr-ganesh, usr-elena, usr-marcus, custom IDs) and primary auth session document

/savedAccounts/{accountId}.description: Top-level collection storing all registered User IDs and full expat profiles

/countryJournals/{countryId}.description: Top-level collection storing private country journal notes and interest ratings

/communityThreads/{threadId}.description: Top-level collection storing community forum discussion threads and comments

/expatMeetups/{meetupId}.description: Top-level collection storing expat meetups and RSVP status

/relocationChecklists/{accountId}.description: Top-level collection storing relocation readiness checklists per User ID

/users/{userId}/savedAccounts/{accountId.description: Subcollection storing all custom User IDs and expat profiles created by the user

/users/{userId}/journalEntries/{countryI.description: Private subcollection containing individual country journal records and interest tracking

/users/{userId}/workspace/{docId}.description: Subcollection storing synced community threads, meetups, messages, and country customizations
